items.q: Ms. Patel has ------- her application for the regional sales manager position to the human resources department.
items.explain:

정답 (D) submitted: '제출하다'

items.q: The latest software update ------- users from accidentally deleting important files stored in shared folders.
items.explain:

items.hint: 빈칸 뒤 「명사 + from + -ing」 짝을 이루는 동사를 떠올리자.

정답 (B) recommended: '권고하다'
